seo_titulo: Grimorium: a horror novel by Antonio López Sánchez
seo_desc: Grimorium (Editorial Oriente, 2018), a horror novel in homage to Lovecraft: three parallel stories around a forbidden book. Back cover and excerpts.
cubierta_alt: Cover of Grimorium, illustrated by Rainel Cabarroi

prensa.pie: Interview by Iyaimí Palomares, Juventud Rebelde, 8 February 2019
Habana Radio, 2019. The original site is down, and the link goes to the Internet Archive copy

catalogo.sinopsis: Three parallel stories, set in different times, whose protagonists pursue the same forbidden book and its ancient, terrifying mystery. Horror built on atmosphere, in homage to Lovecraft.
